feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 19 May 2026 5:56am
items.description:
##Today##

Early outbreaks of rain & drizzle giving way to scattered showers becoming isolated this afternoon, bright intervals. Outbreaks of rain this evening & tonight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 14°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-5


##Wind Speed##

22


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

South or S-SE 20-25, veering SW 15-20 later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in precipitation. Hill fog, especially at first.


##Comments##

Strong wind at times. Slight coastal overtopping around time of high tide (2pm).


##Tomorrow##

Mainly dry with bright or sunny spells. Outbreaks of rain at night.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-3 later


##Wind Speed##

20


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW 20-25 soon decreasing 15-20, backing S-SW later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate or poor later. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Thursday, 21 May 2026##

Early outbreaks of rain then becoming mainly dry with bright spells & sunny intervals, but the risk of coastal mist at times.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-1


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

S-SW 15-20, backing SE 10-15 later in the day, veering overnight to S'ly 15-20.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, becoming poor in any coastal mist. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Friday, 22 May 2026##

Mostly cloudy, risk of coastal mist at times.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-0.5


##Wind Speed##

12


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

South or S-SW 10-15, becoming variable 10 or less overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, perhaps occasionally moderate. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Saturday, 23 May 2026##

Dry and bright with variable cloud, spells of sunshine. Risk of coastal mist at times.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0


##Wind Speed##

10


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

Variable 05-10, settling mainly SE 07-15 for a while.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, moderate or poor in any mist.


##Comments##

Settled for at least a few more days, with high pressure, and becoming warmer.
